corrections.reason: In Col 3 L05, the printed glyph is ቀ (ደቂቀ ፡ አዳምም, 'the children of Adam', construct state ደቂቀ), where the horizontal crossbar of ቀ was misread as ቅ.
In Col 3 L24, the printed glyph is ይፍትሐ (with first-order ሐ), which is the standard Ge'ez subjunctive form.
In Col 4 L34, the printed patristic citation is 'ወይጼልዉ ፡ ከመ፡ ቃለ፡ ቀርን' ('and they resound like the voice of a horn/trumpet', from ጸለወ/ጼለወ). Visually, ጼ and ዉ are clearly printed on the page.
